sloka: अन्ये सुनिशितैः शस्त्रैराकाशे सञ्जघट्टिरे।बभञ्जुश्चिच्छिदुश्चान्ये तयोर्बाणाः सहस्रशः ।। ६.८९.३४ ।।
transliteration: anye suniśitaiḥ śastrairākāśe sañjaghaṭṭire।babhañjuścicchiduścānye tayorbāṇāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।। 6.89.34 ।।

translations.english: In the battle the gold covered arrows fell on their body, dropped out and penetrated into the earth.
